messages:
Sam: FYI I pushed a small preflight change to the infra GH Action to run `terraform fmt --check` early in the workflow. Several infra PRs are failing the job. anyone seen this yet?

Maria: saw it. The repo has some generated TF files under infra/generated/ that get reformatted by codegen, so fmt --check fails on them. We should scope the check to changed paths or ignore generated.

Lee: quick q: how are branch protections configured? If the check is blocking merges then Atlantis applies might be impacted.

Sam: protection requires the preflight job to pass. Atlantis still posts plans but the action exits non-zero before the plan step runs (fmt fails) in the same job, so plan never completes sometimes.

Jordan: simple approach: only run fmt when infra files changed. Example we use in other repos:

``
CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.sha }})
if echo "$CHANGED" | grep -q '^infra/'; then
  terraform fmt -check
else
  echo "no infra changes, skip fmt check"
fi
```

Maria: that works. Another option is to split it into a separate job and temporarily mark it non-required in branch protection until we handle generated files. Less risky.

deploy-bot: ArgoCD: app services/edge-api -> Sync failed: kustomize build error: path 'infra/overlays/prod' not found

Sam: ah this explains the ArgoCD noise. We renamed the overlay to prod-v2 in PR #432. The apply from CI succeeded but ArgoCD app is still pointing at the old path so it can't render.

Lee: ArgoCD won't follow a path rename. We need to update the ArgoCD app manifest or add a CI sanity check to ensure kustomize overlay paths exist when overlays are renamed.

Maria: I'll draft a small script `check-kustomize-paths.sh` that runs in preflight. Pseudo:

``
# iterate changed files under infra/overlays and ensure the overlay dir exists
for f in $(git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.sha }} | grep '^infra/overlays/'); do
  overlay_dir=$(echo "$f" | awk -F/ '{print $1"/"$2"/"$3}')
  if [ ! -d "$overlay_dir" ]; then
    echo "kustomize path $overlay_dir missing"
    exit 1
  fi
done
```

Sam: proposed action items:
1) Scope terraform fmt to changed infra paths or move to a non-blocking job.
2) Add kustomize-path sanity check to preflight.
3) Update the ArgoCD app for services/edge-api to point at infra/overlays/prod-v2.
4) Consider an `infra-ci` required check specifically for Atlantis-friendly flows and make the generic preflight non-blocking temporarily.

Jordan: :thumbsup: Also consider `allow_failure: true` for the fmt job until we fix generated files to avoid blocking merges.

Lee: I'll temporarily relax branch protection for the preflight check on infra/* to unblock merges and revert once the scripts land. Will coordinate with you, Sam.

Sam: thanks. I'll open a PR with the scoped fmt change and tag this thread. Ping me if more failures show up.

Maria: thanks, I'll open the kustomize check PR and add a unit test for the script.
